issueNames.repeated-player: Consecutive rolls assigned to the same player
issueNames.illegal-play: Confirmed result is illegal for the displayed roll
issueNames.observed-move-mismatch: Observed checker arrangement conflicts with the roll
issueNames.dice-disagreement: Settled dice evidence disagreed with the earlier replay
issueNames.unindexed-pair: Stationary dice outside a reconstructed roll

reviewed.text: Both players pick up their individual opening dice and toss again. White’s six and Black’s five decide the opening. White plays 24/13. The sixth checker on point 13 obscured the completed board for the detector.
Black plays 1/11 in the fixed board numbering, leaving one checker on the opening point. The same 6–4 stays in view until pickup.
White moves checkers back and forth during the pause after Black’s pickup. The footage shows no settled dice during these demonstration moves. The next verified roll is White’s 6–6 at 5:01.
White moves two checkers from point 13 to point 1 and hits Black. Only double six legally produces the two verified boards. The detector had read one of the dice as five.
White throws as Black clears the last die. White’s bar/20 and 6/2 play resolves the pale pair as 5–4, including the face the detector read inconsistently.
The two original dice show three and one. The completed board shows White on the bar and two Black checkers on fixed point 20.
White’s 4–1 lands here. The earlier replay started the roll after the checker entered. The pre-roll board and the following board establish bar/21 8/7.
The original dark dice show five and three. The clear board after pickup shows the Black checker from fixed point 11 joining the stack on point 19.
White plays 14/9 and 6/5 before picking up. The two checker positions establish 5–1. A six from the detector is incompatible with the move.
Black’s 6–1 stays visible until the die beside the stack is uncovered and the board is clear at 11:31.16.
Both locations from White’s 5–3 are clear at 11:38.28, before the next throw.
After the game position is cleared, the players start rolling again with one checker each. These throws are outside the scored game.
